items.headline: SoftBank draws over $20B of early interest in its $11B+ junk bond deal for OpenAI funding
items.note: Order book has grown to 2x+ the deal size ahead of Thursday pricing, on track to be the biggest non-financial APAC corporate bond ever — SoftBank is loading record junk debt onto its balance sheet specifically to fund its OpenAI commitments.

items.headline: CoreWeave prices upsized $3.7B convertible notes at 2.875% coupon; stock fell on announcement
items.note: Deal was upsized from a $3B target and priced with a coupon roughly 64% higher than CoreWeave's April convertible, a live read on the company's rising cost of capital as its debt load approaches $36B.

items.headline: Sona Asset Management maps $3.6T of AI financing, flags ~120 of 176 deals as 'highly circular'
items.note: Research names Oracle ($125.3B debt + $288B undisclosed data-center leases) and CoreWeave ($35.6B debt) as the most leveraged nodes in a circular Nvidia-OpenAI-cloud financing web where an OpenAI spending slowdown could cascade through suppliers.

items.headline: Oracle's 5-year CDS spread tops 200bps, matching 2008 crisis levels, as critics say BBB- rating is too generous
items.note: S&P's own projections show Oracle free cash flow declining 32% and staying negative through 2027, yet it kept Oracle one notch above junk — a growing gap between rating-agency assessment and market-implied credit risk.

items.headline: CleanSpark's debut junk bond for a Meta-anchored data center prices at 8.25% yield despite 4x oversubscription
items.note: First-ever junk bond backed by a Meta data-center lease cleared at speculative-grade pricing even with heavy demand, a data point on rising financing costs for AI data-center debt generally.
